verdict.rationale: Zero's own first-party MCP surface lists "Bulk archive emails" alongside label modification and read/unread marking, so some bulk triage exists as a product capability. Nothing in the evidence describes selecting many conversations at once in the client UI, nor bulk labeling or bulk mark-done in one stroke. The MCP surface is only a prose list authenticated with a browser session cookie. missing for 10: in-app multi-select of conversations, bulk label and mark-done actions, UI documentation of one-stroke bulk triage, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
